David_1: son of Jesse (Ruth 4:17), King of Israel (2 Samuel 5:3)
Saul_1: son of Kish (1 Samuel 9:2), King of Israel (1 Samuel 11:15)
Michal_1: daughter of Saul (1 Samuel 14:49) and barren (2 Samuel 6:23) wife of King David (1 Samuel 18:27)
Abner_1: captain of Saul's army and Saul's uncle (1 Samuel 14:50)
Nabal_1: the rich man of Maon, husband of Abigail (1 Samuel 25:3)
Ahinoam_2: of Jezreel.  Same as Ahinoam_1? (see 2 Samuel 12:8)
Abishai_1: son of Zeruiah and Joab's brother (1 Samuel 26:6), chief of "the thirty" of David's men (2 Samuel 23:18)
Zeruiah_1: mother of Abishai, Joab (1 Samuel 26:6), and Asahel (2 Samuel 2:18), sister of King David (1 Chronicles 2:16)
Joab_1: son of Zeruiah (2 Samuel 2:13), commander of David's army (1 Chronicles 27:34)
Asahel_1: brother of Joab and Abishai (2 Samuel 2:18), sixth of "the thirty" of David's men (2 Samuel 23:24)
Amnon_1: firstborn son of King David (2 Samuel 3:2)
Chileab_1: second-born son of King David (2 Samuel 3:3)
Absalom_1: third-born son of King David (2 Samuel 3:3)
Maacah_2: daughter of Talmai, King of Geshur (2 Samuel 3:3)
Adonijah_1: fourth-born son of King David (2 Samuel 3:4)
Shephatiah_1: fifth-born son of King David (2 Samuel 3:4)
Ithream_1: sixth-born son of King David (2 Samuel 3:5)
